asset_type: Transparent pencil illustrations for the Toolbox dashboard

prompts.prompt_builder: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a small editorial pencil illustration for a modern personal software-project dashboard. Medium: genuine hand-drawn graphite pencil, thin confident charcoal-gray outlines, delicate cross-hatching, a few loose construction lines, restrained warm-brown pencil accents. Sophisticated contemporary product illustration, simplified but recognizable. Three-quarter isometric viewpoint, centered compact composition, plenty of transparent negative space at every edge. Background must be genuinely transparent with alpha. No paper texture, no backdrop, no shadows outside the drawing, no border, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people. Not photorealistic, not vector-flat, not glossy 3D, no heavy ink filling. Keep the object complete and unclipped. These three images will be a coordinated illustration family. Subject: an idea becoming a well-organized AI prompt. Draw a tidy stack of three note cards, the top card with a simple chat bubble and five short abstract horizontal pencil strokes (not readable writing); a sharpened wooden pencil rests diagonally beside it, with one small four-point inspiration sparkle above. Use objects only; avoid a whole computer or a phone. The note cards are clean, modern and slightly offset.
